header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH
DATE ORDER WITH SIGNATURE OF JUDGE
None present for the applicant; nor intimation received.
body: This Criminal Misc. Application has been filed for cancellation of bail granted to the respondent No.1 by learned Additional Sessions Judge-I, Umerkot in Criminal Bail Application No. 543/ 2026 vide order dated 10-07-2026, on the following grounds:

“From the perusal of FIR it reflects that FIR is delayed for about 22 days without any plausible explanation, hence its due deliberation and consultation cannot be ruled out. The enmity between the parties is apparent from the contents of FIR. The injury sustained by injured complainant, allegedly caused by present applicant/ accused, which as per final medical certificate was declared as Ghayr-Jaifah Damihah, therefore case of applicant/accused requires further inquiry. The alleged offence does not fall within the prohibitory clause of Section 497 Cr.P.C. The applicant/accused has joined the investigation, he is regularly attending the court and he has not misused the concession of interim pre-arrest bail.”

Perusal of the findings of learned trial court reflects that same are in accordance with law and no illegality or infirmity is found therein, therefore, instant Criminal Misc. Application being devoid of merits stands dismissed in limini. JUDGE “Saleem”
